description: Display and behavior preferences for a signing field.

members.name: Align
members.description: Text alignment, such as left, center, or right.

members.name: FontFamily
members.description: Font family used when rendering text into a document.

members.name: FontSize
members.description: Font size used when rendering text into a document.

members.name: Format
members.description: Field format, such as date format, number format, or signature capture mode.

members.name: Formula
members.description: Formula expression used for computed number or payment fields.

members.name: ReasonFieldUuid
members.description: Field UUID containing the signing reason for a signature field.

members.name: WithLogo
members.description: Whether generated stamp fields should include a logo.

members.name: WithSignatureId
members.description: Whether a signature identifier should be shown near the signature.
